acceptance_predicates.description: Claimed task identity and claim ownership are immutable except through an explicit revision-checked migration transaction.
Concurrent or replayed stale mutations fail without changing the task or generated views.
Collision migration preserves old scope, owner, lease, and history in append-only evidence and assigns a fresh unique id.
Missing worktrees and replica divergence are reported as typed recoverable diagnostics by live doctor.
Duplicate-id, identity-change, migration-replay, race, schema, and generated-view tests pass.

definition_of_done: Protected exact-head PR is independently reviewed and merged.
Post-merge coordinator checks and live doctor pass on the resulting main.
AR-1718 and AR-1719 are reconciled with their intended scope and no unapproved claim change.

inputs.description: Git-backed tasks, specs, plans, claims, leases, and migration evidence.
Configured worktree and replica metadata used by live doctor.

outputs.description: Revision-checked immutable task identity and append-only migration evidence.
Typed live recovery diagnostics and reconciled generated views.

gates.description: All coordinator mutations enforce identity and revision checks.
Concurrent claim/update/migration tests have one linearization winner.
Remote state, projections, worktree diagnostics, and AR collision evidence reconcile cleanly.
